name: bee
description: Bee by HEOSSI: 14 governed intelligence, trust, account, document, memory, and Quantum Reasoning Lab tools over the hosted Bee gateway. Model access follows your plan; Bee Cell is free.
long_description: Bee by HEOSSI - The Progressive Quantum-Native Intelligence Engine - is a governed multimodal intelligence platform (https://bee.heossi.com). This extension runs the hosted `bee-mcp` server: every tool call is forwarded to the Bee gateway over your API key - no GPU or model download. Your API key's plan decides which Bee tiers you can use; set a default tier below or pass `model` on bee_chat. Create a free API key in Bee Workspace. First use after idle may include serverless startup time. Tools call the hosted gateway; chat/search tools are read-only and document/memory writes remain scoped to your Bee account.

api_key.title: Bee API key
api_key.description: Your bee_sk_… key. Create one at https://bee.heossi.com/app/account/api-keys - the free Cell tier works.

model.title: Default model tier
model.description: bee-cell (free), bee-brood, bee-comb, bee-buzz, bee-hive, or bee-swarm. Tier access follows your plan; bee_chat can also pick a tier per call.
